name: StrictMono.exists_between_of_tendsto_atTop
statement: Type*} [LinearOrder β] {t : ℕ → β} (ht_mono : StrictMono t) (ht_tendsto : Tendsto t atTop atTop) {x : β} (hx : t 0 < x) : ∃ n, t n < x ∧ x ≤ t (n + 1)

name: _root_.ContinuousLinearMap.rotation_apply
statement: ℝ) (x : E × E) : ContinuousLinearMap.rotation θ x = (Real.cos θ • x.1 + Real.sin θ • x.2, -Real.sin θ • x.1 + Real.cos θ • x.2)

name: measure_gt_normThreshold_le_rpow
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) (ha_gt : 2⁻¹ < μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) (n : ℕ) : μ {x | normThreshold a n < ‖x‖} ≤ μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} * ((1 - μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) / μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) ^ (2 ^ n)

name: measure_gt_normThreshold_le_exp
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) (ha_gt : 2⁻¹ < μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) (ha_lt : μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} < 1) (n : ℕ) : μ {x | normThreshold a n < ‖x‖} ≤ μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} * .ofReal (rexp (-Real.log (μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} / (1 - μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a})).toReal * 2 ^ n))

name: lintegral_exp_mul_sq_norm_le_mul
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) (ha_pos : 0 < a) {c' : ℝ≥0∞} (hc' : c' ≤ μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) (hc'_gt : 2⁻¹ < c') : ∫⁻ x, .ofReal (rexp (logRatio c' * a⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} * (.ofReal (rexp (logRatio c')) + ∑' n, .ofReal (rexp (-2⁻¹ * Real.log (c' / (1 - c')).toReal * 2 ^ n)))

name: lintegral_exp_mul_sq_norm_le_of_map_rotation_eq_self
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) {c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c ≤ μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) (hc_gt : 2⁻¹ < c) : ∫⁻ x, .ofReal (rexp (logRatio c * a⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) ∂μ ≤ .ofReal (rexp (logRatio c)) + ∑' n, .ofReal (rexp (-2⁻¹ * Real.log (c / (1 - c)).toReal * 2 ^ n))

name: exists_integrable_exp_sq_of_map_rotation_eq_self'
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) {a : ℝ} (ha_pos : 0 < a) (ha_gt : 2⁻¹ < μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a}) (ha_lt : μ {x | ‖x‖ ≤ a} < 1) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ rexp (C * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) μ

name: exists_integrable_exp_sq_of_map_rotation_eq_self_of_isProbabilityMeasure
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ rexp (C * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) μ

name: exists_integrable_exp_sq_of_map_rotation_eq_self
statement: (μ.prod μ).map (ContinuousLinearMap.rotation (-(π / 4))) = μ.prod μ) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ Integrable (fun x ↦ rexp (C * ‖x‖ ^ 2)) μ
